scope: CPU-only functional comparison of complete original CDNA4 vector-copy252 and vec_add1-84 specializations; no GPU or latency measurement.

comparison_contract.unchanged: Whole assembly/object, compiler, driver/helpers, every case/kernel, launch JSON and specification are byte-identical across each comparison.
comparison_contract.attribution_limit: The two verifier revisions include intervening coverage and correctness changes; this is not a single-opcode ablation or a performance study.

historical_preservation.copy_replay: The immutable old binary was rerun over all252 cases with the same current driver used by the candidate; historical reports remain unchanged.
historical_preservation.vec_add1_baseline: Preserved baseline already uses the candidate's exact current driver and helpers; no baseline rerun was needed.
historical_preservation.first_copy_reporting_correction: The earlier contract_error labeling correction remains preserved in baseline.json; it is not overwritten by this comparison.

limits: These are complete configured original one-workgroup launches, not whole-library or application-grid proofs.
Complete mathematical proofs are separate from graph verification; all graph-rejected outcomes stay rejected.
Same-value write/write conflicts are conservative policy findings, not confirmed numerical application bugs.
Remaining unsupported instructions and packed reinterpretations remain inconclusive; neither family is wholly verified.
Arithmetic specifications use the mathematical-real profile, not bit-exact hardware floating-point semantics.
No conclusions about execution latency, GPU performance or device correctness follow from these runs.
